chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 338: Xiao Chen Kills Half-Ancestors in the Dead City
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen, fused with the stone man, slays the Sun Holy God and White Tiger Saint Emperor in the Dead City as the death knell destroys illusory half-ancestors. Shennong and the Ancestral Dragon clash with ultimate power beyond.
og_title: The Stone Man Unleashed: Half-Ancestors Fall in the Dead City
og_description: Xiao Chen wields the Yellow Clay Altar and eight war swords to defeat half-ancestors, while Shennong and the Ancestral Dragon confront an otherworldly being in the void. The war between reality and illusion escalates.
twitter_title: Dead City Carnage: Xiao Chen Slays Half-Ancestors
twitter_description: Fused with the stone man, Xiao Chen kills the Sun Holy God and White Tiger Saint Emperor using eight primordial sounds. The death knell sounds for false gods as cosmic powers clash.
